question: Why does the charcoal offering prescribed in the Yāma tradition not produce ritual fault?
premises: A charcoal offering is prescribed in the Yāma tradition
Some offerings may be thought to cause fault
This prescribed offering is exempt from fault
inference: The charcoal offering stated in the Yāma tradition does not give rise to fault
